High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14720 of 2023

Applicant :- Om Narayan Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Pranshu Agrawal,Alok Sharma,Gaurav Singh,Jitendra Singh Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Pranshu Agrawal, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Abhishek Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.143 of 2023, under Section 420/406/467/468/471/109 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 04.02.2023 against one Sanjay Singh Singla alleging that the informant had purchased a plot in the year 2019 but he was not delivered possession of the land.
The applicant has been implicated subsequently during investigation as he had witnessed the execution of the sale deed.

4. The applicant's criminal history of 17 other cases has been explained in para 29 of the affidavit Om Narayan Yadav vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy. ... on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120142917/
1 filed in support of the bail application, in 8 of which he has been granted bail.
5.

entities.text: Om Narayan Yadav vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has also been submitted on behalf of the applicant that the co-accused Manju Singla and Ravindra Jaiswal have already been enlarged on bail by this court.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the grievance of the informant appears to be against a company and the applicant was neither a director nor other principal position holder in the company and two co-accused persons have already been granted bail and that the applicant is languishing in jail since 19.04.2023 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case,
8. I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail.
9.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Ram.
 
Om Narayan Yadav vs State Of U.P Thru. Addil.
